THE DECLARATION THEREFORE SURVIVES v3.3 ON THE LEDGERABILITY INVARIANT, NOT ON RUBRIC-INDEPENDENCE. Stated falsifiably for future sessions: a NEISO frontier claim on C3c is DISTURBED by any amendment that removes C3c from LEDGERABLE_CRITERIA or promotes it out of the SUPPORTING tier, and is NOT disturbed by one that only re-prices what a ledgered caveat costs the band; v3.3 is the second kind.
